execution.description: The first stage A Constructor launches on two lanes, and the launch faults found before and during them.

expected: A launch on a prepared lane starts its pods, holds its grant and runs to a recorded end.
observed: Seven launch faults: executor configuration (keys and the campaigns.json floor) in a different distro and home than the executor runs in; a pod launch refused with the offered price above the ceiling and no reason text recorded; a pod create environment over the provider's size limit that came back as an opaque HTTP 500 while the probe passed on an empty environment; one controller root admits only one controller; a per-run cap that must hold the token share plus the maximum pods at the ceiling; a lane whose code revision lagged the grant code; a detached launch with no completion watcher.
keep: The preflight checks by path only and never reads a key.
A pod's environment measured before any create, and a probe built from the real pod spec.
Roots distinct, one controller per root.
change: Record the offered price, the ceiling and the reason code when a pod launch is refused.
Read the campaigns.json floor back from the executor's own home before launch.
Derive the per-run cap from the model reservation plus pods times the ceiling, and refuse a grant that fails either.
Compare the lane profile's accepted_revision with the checkout HEAD in the preflight.
Start every detached launch with a completion watcher that records the end state.
